items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Remember any tunes you cut with Jeanette and them? Or Joe Morales?

ctx.x: And every Friday we had a radio show. And every Friday we did a show. And well for a while out there we had Robert Till. We had a radio show. And every Friday we had a radio show. And every Friday we did a show. And well for a while out there we had Robert Till. He was a lieutenant then I think. Lieutenant J.G. And he he fit in a couple times for master ceremonies. When he was in service. We cut a lot of records for overseas. But didn't it. Like I said it wasn't for sale. It was a stick like a sound.
Remember any tunes you cut with Jeanette and them? Or Joe Morales?
Or the name of them? Oh I forgot the name of them.
